1.consolidated_definition: Planta silvestre, ornamental, de hoja y ramas finas que hincan levemente. Sembrada en tiestos colgantes se extiende hacia abajo en bonitos maceteros. Su flor es diminuta. Hay dos o tres variedades.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Wild, ornamental plant with fine leaves and branches that slightly dig in. When sown in hanging pots, it extends downwards into beautiful planters. Its flower is diminutive. There are two or three varieties.
